proposal.opening: You are being evaluated on [your ability](definition.md) to play chess.
proposal.hypothesis: Novel exploratory matched-content hypothesis: the one-word faculty description Knowledge. can produce completed play without supplied-engine searches, as a distinct semantic alternative to Reasoning. Longer knowledge definitions c26bad62367ba and c621fe189eb68 measured 3/3, but their incomplete audits and the custom evaluators reported for ancestor c53b68ba22d7f make absence of alternate computation an unsupported inference. Support requires 3/3 valid clean completions; any supplied-engine search refutes the perfect-cohort prediction, and missing, partial, or errored games never count as successes.
proposal.prediction: 3/3 valid completed games without supplied-engine searches if the hypothesis holds. An equal result to Reasoning. would not establish equivalence, robustness, or unaided play.
proposal.ablation: Replace only Ability. with Knowledge. in ca2634c0d43bd's asset. Relative to the accompanying candidate, replace only Reasoning with Knowledge: a substantive equal-word/equal-byte semantic contrast, holding period, linked opening, file presence/location, remaining game text and actor settings fixed. This tests a knowledge faculty label against a reasoning faculty label without an exclusion or instruction about tools. Asset is one word, 10 UTF-8 bytes, no title or trailing newline, at /workdir/definition.md. Zero added/deleted/replaced rendered prompt words and zero prompt word-edit distance; one file word; 17 markup/target bytes; two target lexical words; three total non-original lexical words; net prompt words zero and net prompt-plus-file words one. Count the file-word replacement as an edit despite equal length. Zero visible opening additions is not an unchanged task. Replace only the original introductory sentence. Historical comparisons remain temporally unmatched, and longer knowledge definitions are motivation rather than matched controls.
